detail: G1-29 XRoboToolkit simulation-lab preflight and deferred headset acceptance resumed.
Pinned plugin/integration/LeRobot revisions, G1-29 URDF hash, package imports, two RTX 5090 GPUs, NVENC, disk, PC Service and no-DDS state checked; automated gates passed.
A 120-sample deterministic artificial bimanual trace validated at 60.0 Hz and replayed through native G1-29 MuJoCo; both sides engaged for 102 frames with finite bounded commands.
Five guided simulation-lab scripts and testable Python helpers implemented in the integration harness; exact headset handoff and removal confirmations exercised.
Operator gate released after the 10-second headset donning window; right-only guided stage started.
Quest sent OPEN_CAMERA; sender connected to 10.9.0.127:12345 and sent the first H.264 access unit.
Simulated arms responded to controller input at a high level; controller-to-robot calibration or frame mapping appeared inaccurate.
Live control terminated with ValueError: Seed exceeds joint limits; video stream ended and all owned processes cleaned up.
Operator confirmed headset removed; run retained as a partial high-level milestone, not a full acceptance pass.
Plugin fix 5017cc3 added bounded measured-seed clipping and diagnostics; integration commit dcdc0d1 added continuously flushed JSONL telemetry and the complete guided workflow.
